content.title: McDonald's KPop Demon Hunters meals are here! What time to get them
content.text: March 31, 2026Updated April 1, 2026, 10:30 a.m. ETThe McDonald's "KPop Demon Hunters" meal is here!The fast-food giant began offering a pair of meals inspired by the Netflix film on Tuesday, March 31.One meal honors the animated movie's female girl group, Huntr/X, who battle demons with music. The other meal celebrates the Saja Boys, a boy band made up of demons, who attempt to disrupt that mission.McDonald's also released a McFlurry inspired by the movie's adorable character, Derpy the Tiger.So, what exactly is in the meals? And when and where can you buy them? Here's what to know:Huntr/X Meal10-piece chicken McNuggetsMedium soft drinkRamyeon McShaker Fries: Fries with a soy, garlic, sesame and spice seasoning. The side is inspired by Rumi, Mira and Zoey's go-to noodle snack. You sprinkle the seasoning into the McShaker bag, add fries and shake to distribute the seasoning on the ries.Hunter Sauce: A sweet chili sauce with notes of chili, garlic and pepper. Inspired by HUNTR/X's "fierce, yet fun-loving personalities," according to the McDonald's release.Demon Sauce: A mustard sauce with heat and tang. The sauce is made purple as a nod to the color of demon patterns.Saja Boys Breakfast MealSpicy Saja McMuffin: The Sausage McMuffin with Egg, topped with a peppery Spicy Saja Sauce. The sauce is "inspired by the fire of Gwi-Ma."Hash browns: "Crispy on the outside and soft on the inside − just like the Saja Boys' leader Jinu," the release reads.Small soft drink: "Your choice of a little 'Soda Pop' to cool down from the heat," the release reads. "Soda Pop" is the name of one of the Saja Boys' songs.The Derpy McFlurryThe Derpy McFlurry blends vanilla soft serve with berry-popping pearls in a wild berry sauce.'KPop Demon Hunters' McDonald's cardsEach meal also comes with a collectible card pack. Each pack consists of a photocard for either Huntr/X or the Saja Boys and a Derpy access card with a QR code that unlocks exclusive content via the McDonald's app. That content is "a special reveal of the group that wins the Battle for the Fans," according to a McDonald's news release.What time does McDonald's stop serving breakfast?Local breakfast menus and hours may vary by restaurant, which Co-Ops and franchisees decide at their discretion, according to the McDonald's website. However, most McDonald's locations serve breakfast items until 10:30 a.m. or 11 a.m. local time.When does McDonald's start serving lunch?Local lunch menus and hours also may vary by restaurant, which Co-Ops and franchisees decide at their discretion. However, the lunch menu generally becomes available when the breakfast menu changes over.
